reader.notes: Both selection loops replace the candidate only on a strict less-than (SelectMin, ExtremeIndex), so the first of equal arguments is kept. Numeric ties cannot be told apart by value; the padding and ALSO probes are the ones that could fail, and they did not. Same output at --std 2023.
